subject.title: Tool error messages surfaced to chat should include failure reason and retry confirmation

question: What tool-failure information is safe to show in normal chat, and when should OpenClaw replace a failure warning with a recovered/succeeded status for the same action?
rationale: Current code and docs deliberately hide raw failure details outside full verbose mode, while the requested retry confirmation affects mutating side-effect and security policy rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Sanitized Recovery Status
options.body: Show a scrubbed reason class or safe receipt plus a same-action recovered confirmation, keeping raw commands and paths in verbose/full diagnostics.

options.title: Keep Details Hidden
options.body: Keep the current normal-mode warning contract and handle only narrower ordering or suppression bugs in related issues.

options.title: Trusted-Channel Details
options.body: Expose richer failure reasons only for explicitly trusted operator channels or admin modes, accepting a larger configuration and audit surface.

recommendation.title: Sanitized Recovery Status
recommendation.body: Show a scrubbed reason class or safe receipt plus a same-action recovered confirmation, keeping raw commands and paths in verbose/full diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: They recently changed the same payload warning policy surface, making them the best code-history routing candidate for the maintainer decision.
